snippet.title: White Creek - Official Announcement Trailer !
snippet.description:
White Creek is a return to Dreamcast-era survival horror, where every encounter is a moral choice.

Explore the cursed town of White Creek as exorcist Alicia Morelli, unearth its buried traumas, and decide whether to kill the possessed or save their souls.

Shoot or exorcise? The choice is yours. Between action and reflection, you can take the risk of exorcising the possessed and adopt a more pacifist approach to your investigation… but at what cost?

Planning to come to Dreamcast, PC, Xbox, PS4 & PS5, and Nintendo Switch

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4856150/White_Creek/
Kickstarter Page: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelheart/white-creek-a-survival-horror-of-mercy-and-madness?tab=prelaunch-updates

Developer: Story Bird Studios
